name: Pulse Plastic Products, Inc.
old_description: Pulse Plastics is a family run custom rotational molding and decorating operation, with a reputation for excellence and reliability.  Our manufacturing facility is located in Auburn, NY, and we have been in business for over 50 years.  Our customers include both large corporations as well as small start-ups, and they span a wide variety of markets, including the gaming and point-of-purchase display industries.
about:
Pulse Plastic Products operates its manufacturing facility in Auburn, New York, while its headquarters are in the Bronx. The company has been in business for over 50 years and is family-run, though the founders are not named in available sources.

The firm specializes in custom rotational molding and decorating, offering a full range of in-house services that include molding, decorating, assembly, and packout. It handles both large and small production runs, promoting an all-in-one facility model that takes concepts through to finished goods. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Pulse serves a mix of large corporations and small start-ups across several markets. Its customer base spans the gaming and redemption industry, point-of-purchase display manufacturers, and producers of mannequin parts. The company also lists general display items among its product categories.

The company emphasizes its ability to deliver intricate 360-degree detail and unbreakable, easy-to-decorate parts. It positions its integrated molding, decorating, and assembly capabilities under one roof as a key differentiator, along with the flexibility to accommodate both high- and low-volume orders.
